findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Subprocess and shell command execution in Pygments
 * @description Identify uses of subprocess or os.system that could be influenced by untrusted data.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/pygments-subprocess
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-078
 */
import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("system").getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["run", "Popen", "call", "check_call", "check_output"]).getACall()
select call, "Shell or subprocess execution; ensure inputs are not attacker-controlled."
findings.hypothesis: Pygments scripts or utilities might invoke system commands (e.g., for external tools or image processing).

message.text: Shell or subprocess execution; ensure inputs are not attacker-controlled.
Shell or subprocess execution; ensure inputs are not attacker-controlled.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Pygments shell/subprocess usage
 * @description Finds invocations of shell/subprocess helpers in Pygments to review for command injection risk.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/pygments-subprocess
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-078
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["Popen", "call", "run", "check_call", "check_output"]).getACall()
  or call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["system", "popen"]).getACall()
select call, "Shell or subprocess execution; ensure inputs are not attacker-controlled."
findings.hypothesis: Pygments may invoke subprocess or shell commands that, if given untrusted input, could lead to command injection.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Pygments usage of eval/exec
 * @description Direct use of eval or exec may lead to code injection if fed with untrusted data.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/pygments-eval-exec
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-094
 */

import python

from Call call, Name func
where
  func = call.getFunc() and
  func.getId() in ["eval", "exec"] and
  call.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath().regexpMatch("^pygments/.*")
select call, "Use of " + func.getId() + "; ensure arguments are not attacker-controlled."

message.text: Use of exec; ensure arguments are not attacker-controlled.
Use of exec; ensure arguments are not attacker-controlled.
